articles.summary: Approvals span elementary, middle, and high school mathematics, expanding access to research-based, personalized learning solutions for Florida educators and students Key Highlights: Florida Department of Education approves McGraw Hill math instructional materials across elementary, middle, and high school mathematics courses. Approved materials include K-8 Florida Math core curriculum, Grades 6-7 Florida Math Accelerated, Algebra 1, Algebra 1 Honors, Geometry, Geometry Honors, Algebra 2, Algebra 2 Honors and Precalculus Honors. McGraw Hill Florida Math delivers research-based curriculum, personalized learning, and data-driven assessment and instructional support designed to improve student achievement and math confidence.
